articles.title: Crystal Front
articles.summary: Square crystal growth terraces around nuclei, twin seams and chipped tips; glassy faceted sparkle. A tidy fine square-spiral pattern, like stepped glass; at distance it becomes an even faceted sparkle.
articles.what: Competing square growth terraces surround nuclei, twin seams, interstitial pockets and chipped tips. Up close: A regular grid of nested concentric squares, about 25-30 px, like stepped terraces or a tiny maze, each with a small dot or corner notch. Squares glow brightly in the highlight on both bases; the satin and metallic halves look very similar. From a distance: A tidy fine square-spiral pattern, like stepped glass; at distance it becomes an even faceted sparkle. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: metal, roughness, clearcoat. Group: Crystal & Mineral (Surface library tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
when: Best on: hood, roof, hero panel.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Surface library tab and the group "Crystal & Mineral", or search for "Crystal Front".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood, roof and hero panels: flat areas show the grid
Avoid curved tight areas where squares distort
Clear nested-square pattern in the highlight, strong
Pairs well with: gloss, metallic, chrome, matte.
pitfalls: Not a crystal paint pattern: it adds no ice blue or white colour
Not a checker: the squares are nested rings, not alternating cells
Avoid: reads noisy at distance, hides under heavy flake.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.title: Add it as an overlay
examples.goal: Layer Crystal Front over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.
